OneKey Founder Says Team “Hacked” the Largest Hardware Wallet, Ledger

OneKey founder Yishi said the OneKey Anzen team reproduced a transaction-replacement attack on Ledger Ethereum App 1.22.1 in the lab. He said a race condition between display logic and the transaction buffer could let an attacker overwrite a pending transaction while the user reviews a legitimate one, so the user may approve transaction A while the device signs transaction B without showing it. Yishi said Ledger fixed it in Ethereum App 1.22.3.
